Man Set Ablaze During Dispute Over Wife, Both He and Rescuer Die

A domestic dispute in Punjab escalated tragically when a man, Lovepreet Singh, was allegedly set ablaze by his brother-in-law while attempting to bring his wife home. Singh later succumbed to his injuries. His sister-in-law, Gurjit Kaur, who reportedly tried to intervene and save him, also died. CCTV footage is said to have captured the incident.
